sections_present: the modified mediterranean ketogenic diet significantly altered the plasma lipidome at a class level
lipid species-specific responses to the modified mediterranean ketogenic diet
the impact of the mmkd intervention to the plasma lipidome was stronger in specific subgroups
alteration to the plasma lipidome with the modified mediterranean ketogenic diet is inversely related to the signature observed in alzheimer’s disease
changes to several csf and cognitive markers of alzheimer’s disease correlated with the changes in the peripheral lipidome
